name: Global Sovereign Data Residency & Localization Compliance
description: Compliance framework for global sovereign data residency and localization mandates (China PIPL / Data Security Law CAC Security Assessment, Russia Federal Law No. 242-FZ, India RBI/IRDAI localization, and EU Sovereign Cloud mandates), covering in-country primary storage, cross-border security assessments, and sovereign encryption keys.
owner: Global Data Sovereignty & Geopolitics Governance Office

checklists.name: Global Sovereign Data Residency Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for China PIPL/DSL, Russia 242-FZ, and sovereign cloud data residency laws.

items.statement: Personal information collected within the Russian Federation is initially recorded and stored in databases physically located in Russia (Law 242-FZ).
Outbound transfers of Important Data or PII exceeding 100k individuals from China undergo formal CAC Security Assessment (PIPL Art. 38/40).
Financial, payment, and healthcare customer data subject to national localization laws is pinned to local cloud data centers.
Encryption keys for sovereign data enclaves are held locally by domestic entities and excluded from foreign cloud provider access.

reviewGates.name: Data Sovereignty & Localization Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Global Data Sovereignty Officer confirms that database pinning, CAC assessments, and local encryption keys meet national data residency laws.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the data residency audit confirm full compliance with national data localization and sovereign storage mandates?
